title: Senator Gillibrand's UAP legislation (Gillibrand-Rubio amendments)

tellings.quote: and it just so happens like one of the the course sort of senators uh involved in on the pro- crypto legislation, uh, Senator Gillibrand is also the same senator who's been involved in some of the initial uh, sort of UAP legislation, the Gillibbran Lummus bill on the crypto side and the Jillen Rubio amendments on the other side.

plain: Senator Kirsten Gillibrand, who backs a pro-crypto bill with another senator, also helped write some of the first laws on UAP (unidentified anomalous phenomena, the official term for UFOs), through amendments she wrote with Senator Marco Rubio between 2020 and 2023. A researcher named Matthew Pines points this out on the show without naming a source, calling it a notable overlap between the two causes.
